text:
mika: FYI compliance flagged tenant-omega — sporadic role escalations to 'owner' after SAML SSO. Low count but we should triage.
jonas: Which IdP and flows? Any recent auth library updates?
mika: Okta via our SAML proxy. Seen this in audit row: 
```
SAML_ATTR roles="\"[\"viewer\",\"owner\"]\"" subject=acct|extid:4444, key_alias=kms/claims-rot
```
mika: Looks like double-escaping: the attribute contains a JSON-array string that's itself quoted. Our normal mapper strips quotes then splits on comma -> picks up owner.
rita: We rolled claim-normalizer-v1.4 yesterday (small tweak to tolerate extra quotes). Maybe it over-normalizes nested quoting.
sec-bot: deploy-bot: claim-normalizer-v1.4 rolled to svc-auth at 1718880000 by jonas
jonas: KMS note — there was an out-of-band rewrap for kms/claims at 1718875000 (infra job). Rewraps sometimes add additional quoting when payload previously encoded.
mika: Repro in staging: pre-wrap payload -> roles=["viewer","owner"]; after we simulate rewrap+decrypt -> roles="\"[\"viewer\",\"owner\"]\"". Our parser removes outer quotes but leaves escaped JSON and then naive split grants owner.
rita: Short-term mitigation: flip config enable_coerce_roles=false for tenant-omega and add a filter that ignores values matching /^\s*"?\[.*\]"?\s*$/ and tries JSON.parse if present.
jonas: I'll push the config canary to prod-safe-1 now. Also please run audit queries for any owner-scoped api actions between 1718870000-1718889999.
mika: running audit query: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" "https://audit-api.internal/query?since=1718870000&until=1718889999&filter=role:owner"
```
mika: result: 2 events (profile.update) both non-destructive. No key ops.
rita: Follow-ups: PR to make normalizer json-first, add unit tests for nested quoting, update SCIM mapping docs (some IdPs send quoted JSON arrays in single attr). Also vuln-triage to review those two events.
jonas: Created alert rule rbac_nested_quote_map -> severity: high -> notify: security-oncall.
sec-bot: alert-config-bot: rbac_nested_quote_map created at 1718890100
mika: Applying config canary now and monitoring 20m. Will update thread with results.
rita: Assigning vuln-triage task VT-112 to sec team for audit deep-dive.
mika: 20m monitor complete — no new owner mappings. :thumbsup:
jonas: After patch shipped, schedule KMS rewrap audit to validate we don't reintroduce quoting for envelope payloads.
rita: Agreed. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes.
